guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: dry upper-mid Marshall crunch with tight low end
tone.profile: dry upper-mid Marshall crunch with tight low end
tone.summary: A tight, mid-focused signal chain using a Marshall-style amp model and 4x12 cabinet to achieve the raw, crunchy upper-mids required for hard rock rhythm playing.
corrections: lean harder into dry hard-rock crunch

rig.name: Led Zeppelin - Good Times Bad Times - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in aggressive playing.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for high-gain rock tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide aggressive pick attack and punch without sounding like a dedicated overdrive.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the initial aggression of an overdriven signal, fulfilling the 'aggressive pick attack' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core hard-rock crunch and upper-mid focus.
blocks.gap: Using the general Distortion model to achieve a raw, punchy rock tone that avoids specific blues or fuzz characteristics.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi tone required for hard rock crunch and bright upper mids.
blocks.gap: None. This model directly addresses the 'Marshall amp' clue.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British hard rock cabinet sound and necessary punch.
blocks.gap: None. Directly matches the '4x12 cab' clue and tone requirement.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the upper mids and tighten the low end as requested.
blocks.gap: None. Used for surgical tone shaping to meet specific frequency requirements (bright upper mids, tight bass).

blocks.purpose: Placeholder. Modulation is avoided to maintain a raw, punchy hard rock sound.
blocks.gap: The Chorus module is included as a required slot but disabled (active: false) because the verdict explicitly avoids complex effects and focuses on raw crunch.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder. Delay is avoided to keep the tone raw and focused on immediate punch.
blocks.gap: The Digital Delay module is included as a required slot but disabled (active: false) because reverb wash or complex ambience was discouraged.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal ambient space without adding a 'reverb wash' or excessive sustain.
blocks.gap: A very low mix of Room reverb is used to add dimension while respecting the 'no reverb wash' rule. This keeps the tone punchy and dry.

blocks.purpose: Final output level control to ensure the tone remains punchy and aggressive.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, punchy hard rock option.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, punchy hard rock character and upper mids.
